name: Rahauro
summary: On Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff, Rahauro sends Horde fighters against threats beneath Orgrimmar. He serves Magatha Grimtotem, coordinating the response to troggs in Ragefire Chasm and the search for a fallen agent’s possessions.

sections.title: Voice of the Elder Crone
sections.body: Rahauro attends Magatha Grimtotem on the high terrace of Elder Rise. He speaks and acts for the elder crone, who relies on trusted servants to recruit others. When wild creatures swarm beneath the orcish capital, Rahauro handles the arrangements and sends Horde mercenaries to face them.

sections.title: Trouble in Ragefire Chasm
sections.body: Troggs in the caverns of Ragefire Chasm rejected Magatha’s attempt to make peace. Her envoys went below Orgrimmar to parley, but the troggs attacked and killed them. Magatha sees the creatures as a threat to the Horde, and Rahauro sends champions into the caverns to thin their numbers and learn their strength.

sections.title: The Fallen Envoy's Satchel
sections.body: Maur Grimtotem served Magatha and was among those killed by the troggs. Before he died in Ragefire Chasm, Maur found something he meant to show his mistress. Rahauro sends explorers through the volcanic paths to recover Maur’s lost satchel and whatever findings it holds.

faq.answer: Rahauro attends Magatha Grimtotem on Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff. He directs travelers to act for his mistress and the Horde.
You can find Rahauro on Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff, near Magatha Grimtotem.

faq.q: Why does Rahauro want adventurers to go to Ragefire Chasm?
faq.answer: Magatha sent envoys to negotiate with the troggs beneath Orgrimmar, but the troggs killed them. Rahauro sends adventurers into Ragefire Chasm to thin their numbers and counter the threat to the Horde.
Maur Grimtotem served Magatha and went into Ragefire Chasm as her envoy. He found something noteworthy in the caves, but troggs killed him before he could bring it to her.

faq.q: What is inside the lost satchel Rahauro seeks?
faq.answer: The lost satchel holds something Maur Grimtotem discovered before his death. Rahauro wants it recovered from the trogg-infested caves and brought safely to Thunder Bluff.

faq.q: Does Rahauro belong to the Grimtotem tribe?
faq.answer: Rahauro attends Magatha Grimtotem on Elder Rise and oversees matters involving agents such as Maur. His service places him within Magatha’s retinue in Thunder Bluff.

angles.text: As a member of the Horde, you can take on Rahauro’s early dungeon assignments in Thunder Bluff. They serve the tauren leadership and defend Orgrimmar, the orcish capital.
As a tauren on Thunder Bluff’s terraces, you can see how Magatha’s influence reaches beyond Elder Rise. Rahauro works within her inner circle.
